## 4.2 A risky zero-coupon bond

```{r step-013}
#| ref.label: [core-discount_factor, core-price_zero_defaultable]
```

```{r step-014}
zero_risk_free_price <- example_face * discount_factor(example_r, 5)

zero_risky_price <- price_zero_defaultable(
  face = example_face,
  r = example_r,
  recovery = example_recovery,
  h = example_h
)

zero_risky_yield <- (example_face / zero_risky_price)^(1 / 5) - 1

zero_spread <- zero_risky_yield - example_r
```

### Table 4.3 {#result-table-4-3}

```{r table-4-3}
zero_table <- data.frame(
  Quantity = c(
    "Risk-free zero-coupon price",
    "Risky zero-coupon price",
    "Risky zero-coupon yield",
    "Credit spread"
  ),
  Value = c(
    fmt_price(zero_risk_free_price, 3),
    fmt_price(zero_risky_price, 3),
    fmt_pct(zero_risky_yield, 3),
    paste0(fmt_bps(zero_spread, 1), " bps")
  )
)

companion_kable(zero_table, caption = "Risk-free and risky zero-coupon valuation.")
```

### How default risk changes price and spread

```{r step-023}
h_grid <- seq(0.001, 0.10, length.out = 100)

coupon_sensitivity <- data.frame(
  h = h_grid,
  price = sapply(h_grid, function(h) {
    price_coupon_defaultable(
      face = example_face,
      coupon_rate = example_coupon_rate,
      r = example_r,
      recovery = example_recovery,
      h = rep(h, 5)
    )
  })
)

coupon_sensitivity$yield <- sapply(coupon_sensitivity$price, function(price) {
  coupon_bond_ytm(
    price = price,
    face = example_face,
    coupon_rate = example_coupon_rate,
    maturity = 5
  )
})

coupon_sensitivity$spread_bps <- 10000 * (coupon_sensitivity$yield - example_r)

coupon_sensitivity_plot <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    h = coupon_sensitivity$h,
    value = coupon_sensitivity$price,
    metric = "Bond price"
  ),
  data.frame(
    h = coupon_sensitivity$h,
    value = coupon_sensitivity$spread_bps,
    metric = "Credit spread (bps)"
  )
)

coupon_sensitivity_plot$metric <- factor(
  coupon_sensitivity_plot$metric,
  levels = c("Bond price", "Credit spread (bps)")
)

plot_fig_coupon_price_spread <- ggplot(coupon_sensitivity_plot, aes(x = h, y = value, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2)
```

```{r step-026}
rw_pd_example <- 0.01

rw_recovery_example <- 0.40

market_spread_example <- 0.012

rw_default_loss_spread <- rw_pd_example * (1 - rw_recovery_example)

spread_implied_h_example <- market_spread_example / (1 - rw_recovery_example)

extra_spread_example <- market_spread_example - rw_default_loss_spread
```

### Using the Merton PD to price protection

```{r step-029}
merton_cds_recovery <- 0.40

merton_cds_h <- pd_merton

merton_cds_spread <- cds_fair_spread(
  r = rf,
  recovery = merton_cds_recovery,
  h = merton_cds_h
)

merton_cds_legs <- cds_legs(
  notional = 100,
  r = rf,
  recovery = merton_cds_recovery,
  h = merton_cds_h,
  spread = merton_cds_spread
)
```

```{r step-030}
merton_cds_table <- data.frame(
  Quantity = c(
    "Merton risk-neutral one-year PD",
    "Recovery assumption",
    "Loss given default",
    "Fair one-year CDS spread",
    "PV protection leg per 100 notional",
    "PV premium leg per 100 notional"
  ),
  Value = c(
    fmt_pct(pd_merton, 4),
    fmt_pct(merton_cds_recovery, 0),
    fmt_pct(1 - merton_cds_recovery, 0),
    paste0(fmt_bps(merton_cds_spread, 1), " bps"),
    fmt_price(merton_cds_legs$protection_leg, 4),
    fmt_price(merton_cds_legs$premium_leg, 4)
  )
)
```

### An optional connection to default intensity

```{r cds-midpoint-core-display}
#| ref.label: core-cds_midpoint
```

```{r step-047}
cds_timing_grid <- function(intervals_per_year) {
  dt <- 1 / intervals_per_year
  value <- cds_midpoint(hull_hazard, hull_r, hull_recovery, hull_maturity,
    intervals_per_year, premium_annuity = hull_components$premium_annuity,
    ends = seq(dt, hull_maturity, by = dt))
  data.frame(
    intervals = intervals_per_year,
    interval_pd = -expm1(-hull_hazard * dt),
    survival = exp(-hull_hazard * hull_maturity),
    spread = value$spread
  )
}
cds_timing_results <- do.call(rbind,
  lapply(c(1, 4, 12, 365), cds_timing_grid))
```

### Table 4.15 {#result-table-4-15}

```{r table-4-15}
companion_kable(data.frame(
  "Intervals per year" = cds_timing_results$intervals,
  "Interval PD" = fmt_pct(cds_timing_results$interval_pd, 4),
  "Five-year survival" = fmt_pct(cds_timing_results$survival, 4),
  "Fair spread (bp)" = fmt_bps(cds_timing_results$spread, 4),
  check.names = FALSE
), caption = "Refining default timing while retaining annual CDS premiums.")
```

### Contract value and spread-implied default risk

```{r step-050}
hull_contract_spread <- 0.015

hull_mtm_seller <- hull_components$risky_annuity_with_accrual * hull_contract_spread -
  hull_components$protection_leg

hull_mtm_buyer <- -hull_mtm_seller
```

### Estimating a credit curve from the other bonds

```{r step-074}
#| eval: false
h <- seq(endpoints[1], endpoints[2], length.out = 8)
survival <- exp(as.vector(bond$exposure %*% log1p(-h)))
default <- c(1, head(survival, -1)) - survival
discount <- rv_discount(bond$time, curve, bond$settlement)
clean_value <- sum(discount * bond$coupon * survival) +
  100 * recovery * sum(discount * default) +
  100 * tail(discount * survival, 1) - bond$accrued
```

### Testing the assumptions behind the preference

```{r step-081}
rv_grid <- expand.grid(recovery = c(0.20, 0.40, 0.60),
  shift = c(-0.0025, 0, 0.0025), weight = c("dv01", "price"),
  timing = c("end", "midpoint"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r step-082}
rv_sensitivity <- lapply(rv_targets, function(i) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(rv_grid)), function(j) {
    g <- rv_grid[j, ]
    x <- rv_evaluate(i, rv_bonds, rv_curve, g$recovery, g$shift, g$weight, g$timing)
    data.frame(g, residual = x$residual_bp, boundary = x$boundary)
  }))
})
rv_pairs <- merge(rv_sensitivity[[1]], rv_sensitivity[[2]],
  by = c("shift", "weight", "timing"), suffixes = c("_CCO", "_Verizon"))
rv_pairs$advantage <- rv_pairs$residual_CCO - rv_pairs$residual_Verizon
stopifnot(!any(rv_pairs$boundary_CCO | rv_pairs$boundary_Verizon))
rv_peer_ranges <- lapply(seq_along(rv_targets), function(k) {
  vapply(rv_results[[k]]$train, function(j) {
    rv_evaluate(rv_targets[k], rv_bonds, rv_curve, omit = j)$residual_bp
  }, numeric(1))
})
rv_peer_range <- c(min(rv_peer_ranges[[1]]) - max(rv_peer_ranges[[2]]),
                   max(rv_peer_ranges[[1]]) - min(rv_peer_ranges[[2]]))
rv_term_advantage <- vapply(c(3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5), function(knot) {
  x <- lapply(rv_targets, function(i) {
    rv_evaluate(i, rv_bonds, rv_curve, shape = "step", knot = knot)
  })
  stopifnot(!any(vapply(x, function(z) z$boundary, logical(1))))
  x[[1]]$residual_bp - x[[2]]$residual_bp
}, numeric(1))
rv_sensitivity_summary <- data.frame(
  check = c("Recovery, rates, weighting, timing", "Omit one additional bond per issuer",
            "Two-level default curve"),
  low = c(min(rv_pairs$advantage), rv_peer_range[1], min(rv_term_advantage)),
  high = c(max(rv_pairs$advantage), rv_peer_range[2], max(rv_term_advantage))
)
rv_all_residuals <- vapply(seq_along(rv_bonds), function(i) {
  rv_evaluate(i, rv_bonds, rv_curve)$residual_bp
}, numeric(1))
rv_rmse <- vapply(c("CCO", "Verizon"), function(issuer) {
  sqrt(mean(rv_all_residuals[rv_inputs$issuer == issuer]^2))
}, numeric(1))
```

## 4.9 A sovereign bond and implied default risk

### From the issue terms to the promised payments

```{r step-089}
brazil_face <- 100
brazil_coupon_rate <- 0.06625
brazil_issue_price <- 99.091
brazil_reported_yield <- 0.06750
brazil_benchmark_yield <- 0.04550
brazil_settlement <- as.Date("2025-02-25")
brazil_payment_dates <- seq(as.Date("2025-09-15"),
                            as.Date("2035-03-15"), by = "6 months")
```

```{r step-090}
brazil_first_days <- 30 * (9 - 2) + (15 - 25)
brazil_time <- brazil_first_days / 360 +
  (seq_along(brazil_payment_dates) - 1) / 2
brazil_interval <- diff(c(0, brazil_time))
brazil_coupons <- brazil_face * brazil_coupon_rate * brazil_interval
brazil_promised <- brazil_coupons
brazil_promised[length(brazil_promised)] <-
  tail(brazil_promised, 1) + brazil_face
brazil_T <- tail(brazil_time, 1)
```

```{r table-4-25}
      caption = "First two and last two promised payments of the Brazilian sovereign bond, per 100 of principal.",
      row.names = FALSE)
```

### Checking the price and yield before inferring default risk

```{r step-092}
brazil_price_from_yield <- function(y) {
  sum(brazil_promised / (1 + y / 2)^(2 * brazil_time))
}
brazil_yield <- uniroot(
  function(y) brazil_price_from_yield(y) - brazil_issue_price,
  interval = c(0, 0.20), tol = 1e-12
)$root
brazil_price_at_reported_yield <-
  brazil_price_from_yield(brazil_reported_yield)
brazil_spread <- brazil_yield - brazil_benchmark_yield
```

### Matching the price under an explicit recovery assumption

```{r step-093}
brazil_credit_price <- function(h, recovery) {
  survival <- (1 - h)^brazil_time
  default <- c(1, head(survival, -1)) - survival
  discount <- (1 + brazil_benchmark_yield / 2)^(-2 * brazil_time)
  sum(discount * (brazil_coupons * survival +
                   brazil_face * recovery * default)) +
    brazil_face * tail(discount * survival, 1)
}
brazil_implied_h <- function(recovery) {
  uniroot(function(h) brazil_credit_price(h, recovery) -
            brazil_issue_price,
          interval = c(0, 0.90), tol = 1e-12)$root
}
brazil_recovery <- 0.40
brazil_h <- brazil_implied_h(brazil_recovery)
brazil_pd_maturity <- 1 - (1 - brazil_h)^brazil_T
brazil_repriced <- brazil_credit_price(brazil_h, brazil_recovery)
brazil_no_default_price <- brazil_credit_price(0, brazil_recovery)
```

### Changing recovery with the price or default probability held fixed

```{r step-094}
brazil_recoveries <- c(0.20, 0.40, 0.60)
brazil_h_values <- vapply(brazil_recoveries, brazil_implied_h, numeric(1))
brazil_sensitivity <- data.frame(
  recovery = brazil_recoveries,
  annual_pd = brazil_h_values,
  maturity_pd = 1 - (1 - brazil_h_values)^brazil_T,
  repriced = mapply(brazil_credit_price, brazil_h_values,
                   brazil_recoveries),
  price_at_fixed_h = vapply(brazil_recoveries,
    function(R) brazil_credit_price(brazil_h, R), numeric(1))
)
```

```{r table-4-26}
companion_kable(data.frame(
  `Recovery assumption` = fmt_pct(brazil_sensitivity$recovery, 0),

  `Fitted maturity PD` = fmt_pct(brazil_sensitivity$maturity_pd, 4),

row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r step-096}
brazil_recovery_grid <- seq(0.20, 0.60, length.out = 81)
brazil_curve <- data.frame(
  recovery = brazil_recovery_grid,
  maturity_pd = 1 - (1 - vapply(brazil_recovery_grid,
                              brazil_implied_h, numeric(1)))^brazil_T
)
plot_brazil_recovery <- ggplot(brazil_curve,
  aes(x = recovery, y = maturity_pd)) +
  geom_line(color = book_plot_colors[["primary"]], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = brazil_sensitivity,
             color = book_plot_colors[["primary"]], size = 2.8)
```

### An analyst's valuation checklist

```{r step-098}
credit_spread_checklist <- data.frame(
  Step = c(
    "1. Define the instrument",
    "2. Choose the risk-free benchmark",
    "3. Reconcile quote conventions",
    "4. Specify recovery",
    "5. Translate the market spread",
    "6. Reprice the bond or CDS",
    "7. Compare market and model spreads",
    "8. Stress the assumptions"
  ),
  Analyst_question = c(
    "What promised cash flows are being priced?",
    "Which default-free curve or benchmark is the comparison point?",
    "Do the price and yield use the same cash-flow schedule as the model?",
    "How much value is recovered if default occurs?",
    "What default rate is roughly implied by the observed spread?",
    "What spread or price follows from the analyst's default view?",
    "Does the market pay more or less than the model requires?",
    "Does the conclusion survive changes in PD, recovery, and liquidity assumptions?"
  ),
  Output = c(
    "coupon, maturity, face value, seniority",
    "discount factors or benchmark yield",
    "price-consistent yield and spread",
    "recovery rate and loss given default",
    "spread-implied h or PD",
    "model price, fair spread, or fair CDS spread",
    "spread gap and price gap",
    "robust, fragile, or inconclusive signal"
  )
)

names(credit_spread_checklist) <- c("Step", "Analyst question", "Output")
```
